cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -E '"(version|main|module|types)"' ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components 2>/dev/null | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index* 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/controls/index.d.ts; ls components/controls; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls components/Switch components/Checkbox components/Select components/Avatar; sed -n 1,80p components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts

cat components/Select/Select.d.ts | head -150; echo ---; cat components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat components/controls/types.d.ts | head -60

cat components/Select/types.d.ts | head -120; echo ---; cat components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; ls components/Avatar/types; echo ---; cat components/Checkbox/index.d.ts; cat components/Switch/index.d.ts; echo; ls components/layout; grep -n "export" components/layout/index.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls components/Text; echo ---; grep -rn "export" components/Card/index.d.ts | head; ls components/Card; ls components/Icon; grep -n "export" components/Icon/index.d.ts

cat components/Avatar/AvatarImage/index.d.ts components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls components/Avatar/AvatarImage components/Avatar/AvatarText; cat components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "ControlGroupOption" -A8 components/types.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat components/Select/tech-components.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "export" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems\|justifyContent" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n "export declare const\|interface\|VariantType\|variant" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -20

cat components/Button/constants.d.ts; grep -n "content\|children" components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; grep -rn "export declare const Toaster\b\|export declare" components/Toaster/index.d.ts | head -3; cat ../../../../../node_modules/.bin/tsc 2>/dev/null >/dev/null; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --version && npx vite --version 2>/dev/null | head -2; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "ControlProps" -A25 components/types.d.ts | head -45; echo ---; cat components/Alert/Alert.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "color" components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -10; grep -rn "'secondary'\|'danger'" components/Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head -3
cat components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -6; grep -rn "TEXT_COLORS" components/Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head -3; cat components/Alert/types.d.ts | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | head -60; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -15; echo "---"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright; python3 -c "import playwright" 2>&1 | tail -1
rm -rf .verify && git status --short && wc -l src/App.tsx src/profile/*.ts* && npx tsc --noEmit >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "tsc exit=$?"
